verdict.rationale: The only automation evidence is a Scheduled Task feature ('Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest'). That gives time-based triggers, not user-defined rules that fire on arbitrary events. IM Gateway and Messenger integrations let agents respond inside chat platforms, but nothing documents configurable event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: a user-definable rule/trigger engine, event sources beyond time schedules (e.g., webhooks or app events), conditional logic, depth of documentation on how scheduled tasks are configured, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
